answer: You want Sybils to pay? They must grow a computable grove of receipts per identity, each audited against a reef of prior votes. The fable of parallel audits fails here: each added clone forces a peer to re-execute receipts, burning 0.5s of CPU per head. No ASIC farms bypass this, since the work is provably unbatchable—identity costs scale linearly, tied to the executor’s willow-clock.
